"""Verify actual packaged browser and CLI replays against the frozen main evidence."""
import gzip,hashlib,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/josh/projects/klem')
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def read(path):
 p=Path(path);data=p.read_bytes();return json.loads(gzip.decompress(data) if p.suffix=='.gz' else data)
def verify():
 gate=read('/tmp/klem-past-prefinal-final-nix.json')
 assert gate['state']=='passed' and gate['exit_code']==0 and gate['snapshot_unchanged']
 assert len(gate['outputs'])==3
 log=Path('/tmp/klem-past-prefinal-final-nix.log').read_bytes();assert sha(log)==gate['log_sha256']
 rows=re.findall(r'^klem> test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored',log.decode(),re.M)
 assert len(rows)==214 and [sum(int(row[i]) for row in rows) for i in range(3)]==[1012,0,1]
 assert 'Running tests/past_prefinal.rs' in log.decode() and 'Ran 13 tests' in log.decode()
 for name,value in gate['snapshot']['files'].items():assert sha((ROOT/name).read_bytes())==value['sha256']
 assert sha(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--binary'],cwd=ROOT))==gate['snapshot']['staged_diff_sha256']
 cli=read('/tmp/klem-past-prefinal-packaged-cli.json')
 assert cli['state']=='passed' and cli['exit_code']==0 and cli['inputs_unchanged'] and cli['cli_bytes_identical_to_original']
 assert cli['package'] in gate['outputs']
 source=read(ROOT/'docs/past-prefinal-source-discovery.json.gz')
 boundary=read(ROOT/'docs/past-prefinal-boundary-capture.json.gz')
 assert cli['source_capture_sha256']==sha((ROOT/'docs/past-prefinal-source-discovery.json.gz').read_bytes())
 assert cli['boundary_capture_sha256']==sha((ROOT/'docs/past-prefinal-boundary-capture.json.gz').read_bytes())
 assert len(cli['runs'])==6 and len(cli['controls'])==40
 for run,original in zip(cli['runs'],source['runs'],strict=True):
  assert run['sha256']==original['sha256'] and run['records']==638 and run['exact_archived_output'] and run['exit_code']==0
  assert (run['encoding'],run['mode'])==(original['encoding'],original['mode'])
 for run,original in zip(cli['controls'],boundary['runs'],strict=True):
  assert run['sha256']==original['sha256'] and run['exact_archived_output'] and run['exit_code']==0
  assert (run['surface'],run['encoding'],run['mode'])==(original['surface'],original['encoding'],original['mode'])
 assert sha(cli['producer']['text'].encode())==cli['producer']['sha256']
 browser=read('/tmp/klem-past-prefinal-packaged-browser.json')
 main=read(ROOT/'docs/past-prefinal-main-browser.json.gz')
 assert len(browser['diagrams'])==90 and len(browser['native'])==99 and len(browser['exports'])==6 and len(browser['opened'])==3 and not browser['errors']
 assert browser['cli_sha256']==cli['frozen_inputs'][cli['package']+'/bin/klem']
 assert browser['suite_sha256']==main['suite_sha256']
 assert browser['producer_sha256']==sha(Path('/tmp/klem-past-prefinal-packaged-browser.mjs').read_bytes())
 for key in ['diagrams','native','exports','opened']:assert browser[key]==main[key],key
 for run,original in zip(browser['responses'],main['responses'],strict=True):
  assert run['request']==original['request'] and run['encoding']==original['encoding']
  assert {k:v for k,v in run['response'].items() if k!='elapsed_ms'}=={k:v for k,v in original['response'].items() if k!='elapsed_ms'}
 legacy=read('/tmp/klem-past-prefinal-packaged-legacy-browser.json')
 old=read(ROOT/'docs/past-prefinal-main-legacy-browser.json.gz')
 assert len(legacy['diagrams'])==220 and len(legacy['native'])==208 and len(legacy['records'])==6 and not legacy['errors']
 assert legacy['cli_sha256']==browser['cli_sha256']
 assert legacy['suite_sha256']==old['suite_sha256'] and legacy['producer_sha256']==old['producer_sha256']
 for key in ['diagrams','native','records']:assert legacy[key]==old[key],key
 for run,original in zip(legacy['responses'],old['responses'],strict=True):
  assert run['request']==original['request'] and run['encoding']==original['encoding']
  assert {k:v for k,v in run['response'].items() if k!='elapsed_ms'}=={k:v for k,v in original['response'].items() if k!='elapsed_ms'}
 return {'state':'packaged-source-and-browser-preservation-passed','release_rust_passed':1012,'ignored':1,'batches':214,'source_streams':6,'frames_per_stream':638,'boundary_calls':40,'diagrams':90,'legacy_diagrams':220,'exports':12,'native_entries':99,'legacy_native_entries':208,'opened_past_sources':3,'all_main_candidate_native_ordered_and_export_evidence_exact':True}
if __name__=='__main__':print(json.dumps(verify(),ensure_ascii=False))
